_about: Every item in the game: {name, category, price, description, effect}. price is in Pokedollars -- null when it has none, or a text ("Not sold", "Varies"). From the user's item list (2026-10-19). Read by the Pi server (gamedata.py); edit here, commit, git pull on the Pi -- no restart needed.

items.description: A handheld device for illuminating dark areas.
items.effect: Casts bright light in a 15-foot cone and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Requires a new energy cell after 4 hours of use.

items.name: Flint and Steel

items.name: Climber's Kit
items.description: A set of tools for climbing.
items.effect: Includes special pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness. You have advantage on climbing checks and you can't fall more than 25 ft. if you do. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

items.name: Cooking Kit
items.description: A set of tools for cooking.
items.effect: Includes pots, pans, utensils and molds for cooking. Used to make foods while in a kitchen or similar facility. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

items.name: Gardener's Kit
items.description: A set of tools for gardening.
items.effect: Includes clippers, gloves, a spade and watering pale. It's everything needed to gather and care for plants, berries and apricorn trees. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

items.name: Diver's Kit
items.description: A set of equipment for diving.
items.effect: Includes a wetsuit, diving belt, mask, fins and air tanks. While worn it reduces your movement speed by 20 ft., but gives you a swimming speed of 30 ft. In addition you have 2 hours of air, can dive to a depth of 200 ft. and aren't affected by the water's temperature.

items.name: Singing Reed
items.description: A hollow reed that produces musical notes in the wind, often used by Agiluzz for nest-building.
items.effect: Used in wind instruments. Enhances the power of sound-based moves when used as a held item.

items.name: Whispergrass
items.description: A tall grass native to the plains of Shima that makes soft whispering sounds when the wind blows through it.
items.effect: Often used in traditional ceremonies to communicate with nature spirits. Woven into good luck charms.

items.name: Mountainheart
items.description: A sturdy, low-growing shrub found in the high altitudes of the central mountain range.
items.effect: Its leaves are brewed into a tea that's popular among mountain climbers and hikers for its invigorating properties.

items.name: Tideclock Algae
items.description: A bioluminescent algae that grows along the Libra Coast, changing color with the tides.
items.effect: Used by local fishermen to predict the best fishing times. Also used in decorative timepieces.

items.name: Dustbloom
items.description: A resilient flower that thrives in the Aridune Desert, blooming briefly after rare rainfalls.
items.effect: Its sudden blossoming is seen as a symbol of hope and perseverance in desert communities.

items.name: Mistmantle
items.description: A moss-like plant that grows on tree trunks in Evershroud City, absorbing moisture from the air.
items.effect: Collected and dried for use in humidity-controlling sachets. Also used in traditional medicine for respiratory ailments.

items.name: Sunburst Vine
items.description: A climbing plant with bright yellow flowers that open at dawn, common in Florinex.
items.effect: Its nectar is a key ingredient in a popular morning beverage. The flowers are also used in festivals celebrating the summer solstice.

items.name: Frostfern
items.description: A delicate, crystalline fern that grows in the coldest regions of the Driftlands.
items.effect: Its fronds are carefully harvested to create intricate, never-melting ice sculptures prized by collectors.

items.name: Emberspice
items.description: A red, pepper-like plant that grows near volcanic vents in Rugitus Coast.
items.effect: Known for its intense heat, it's used sparingly in local cuisine. Also used in fire-dancing rituals.

items.name: Whispering Willow
items.description: A tree with silver leaves that make soft, bell-like sounds, found near Pax Cove.
items.effect: Its wood is prized for making musical instruments. Sitting under a Whispering Willow is said to bring clarity of thought.

items.name: Luminous Lily
items.description: A water lily that glows softly at night, found in the lakes of Montevera.
items.effect: Used to create natural, long-lasting light sources. Its presence is said to purify water and attract benevolent water spirits.

items.name: Chronomoss
items.description: A moss found in the Temporal Ruins that seems to age and regrow rapidly.
items.effect: Studied by scientists for its unusual properties. Local legends say it can show visions of the past or future.

items.name: Skyreach Bamboo
items.description: An incredibly tall and fast-growing bamboo native to Zephyria.
items.effect: Used in sustainable construction and in crafting wind instruments. Climbing to the top is a rite of passage for local youth.

items.name: Deeproot Oak
items.description: An ancient species of oak tree found in the oldest parts of Grunholt Forest.
items.effect: Its acorns are said to grant wisdom when carried. The trees are often sites of important community gatherings.

items.name: Stardust Flower
items.description: A rare, glittering flower that blooms only on clear nights, found near Celestis.
items.effect: Its pollen is used in high-end cosmetics. Seeing one bloom is considered a sign of good fortune.

items.name: Echoshroom
items.description: A mushroom that grows in the caves near Sandstone, known for amplifying and echoing sounds.
items.effect: Used by cave explorers to navigate through echolocation. Also used in traditional sound healing practices.

items.name: Echoquartz
items.description: A resonating crystal found in the Singing Dunes, known for its ability to amplify and store sounds.
items.effect: Used in high-end sound equipment and communication devices. Sacred to musicians in desert cultures.

items.name: Stormstone
items.description: A magnetic stone from Estwal City that seems to attract lightning during storms.
items.effect: Used in weather control experiments and to create lightning rods. Believed to grant protection from storms.

items.name: Chromaore
items.description: A multicolored ore found in the Silverpeak Range that changes color based on temperature.
items.effect: Highly prized by jewelers and alchemists. Used in mood-detecting devices and temperature-sensitive art.

items.name: Whispering Pebble
items.description: Small, smooth stones from riverbeds in the Whispering Woods that seem to murmur when held to the ear.
items.effect: Used in meditation practices and by storytellers. Believed to contain wisdom from the rivers.

items.name: Nebula Glass
items.description: A dark, glasslike substance found near Celestis that seems to contain swirling galaxies within.
items.effect: Used in high-precision lenses and scrying devices. Highly valued by astronomers and fortune-tellers.

items.name: Temporite
items.description: A shimmering crystal from the Temporal Ruins that seems to age and de-age randomly.
items.effect: Studied intensively by researchers. Legends say it can grant visions of the past or future.

items.name: Magmaheart
items.description: A pulsing, warm stone found in volcanic caves of Rugitus Coast.
items.effect: Used in geothermal energy systems and to create long-lasting heat sources. Revered by fire dancers.

items.name: Frostfire Opal
items.description: A unique opal from the Snowspine mountains that burns cold instead of hot.
items.effect: Prized in jewelry and used in advanced cooling systems. Sacred to tribes living in extreme cold.

items.name: Verdant Geode
items.description: A hollow rock filled with crystal formations resembling miniature forests, found in Mystaura.
items.effect: Used in terrariums and believed to promote plant growth. Valued by botanists and gardeners.

items.name: Mist Marble
items.description: A smooth, opaque stone from Mistral Cove that exudes a light fog when wet.
items.effect: Used in humidity control systems and atmospheric art installations. Believed to hide one from evil spirits.

items.name: Psychic Sandstone
items.description: A coarse, glittering sandstone from the Aridune Desert that resonates with psychic energy.
items.effect: Used in mental focusing aids and psionic research. Valued by psychics and meditation practitioners.

items.name: Skyshard
items.description: Fragments of a mysterious blue crystal often found after meteor showers.
items.effect: Used in levitation devices and anti-gravity experiments. Believed to be of extraterrestrial origin.

items.name: Harmonite
items.description: A crystal from the Grunholt Forest that produces harmonic tones when struck.
items.effect: Used in high-quality musical instruments and sound therapy.

items.name: Depthmire Pearl
items.description: A dark, iridescent pearl found in the deepest parts of swamps near Dewport.
items.effect: Highly valued in jewelry and believed to grant water breathing abilities. Used in underwater exploration equipment.

items.name: Ferromoss Crystal
items.description: A metallic, moss-like crystal formation found in caves near Ferronix.
items.effect: Used in metal purification processes and to create durable alloys. Believed to strengthen metal items.

items.name: Shimmersilk Ore
items.description: A rare metallic ore with a fibrous structure that can be spun into incredibly strong, lightweight threads.
items.effect: Highly sought after by high-end armor crafters and fashion designers in Venustia.

items.name: Resonance Quartz
items.description: A crystal that vibrates at specific frequencies, found only in the Singing Dunes.
items.effect: Essential for creating the famous musical instruments of the desert nomads.

items.name: Verdant Fossil
items.description: Petrified wood from ancient forests, still carrying trace amounts of life energy.
items.effect: Prized by scholars in Mystaura for its historical and botanical significance.

items.name: Tempest Pearl
items.description: Incredibly rare pearls formed in the eye of maelstroms off the Rugitus Coast.
items.effect: Viewed as the ultimate status symbol among the seafaring communities.

items.name: Nebula Glass
items.description: A mysterious substance found in impact craters near Celestis, containing swirling, galaxy-like patterns.
items.effect: Invaluable for astronomers and often integrated into high-precision lenses.

items.name: Chromatic Salt
items.description: Multicolored salt crystals from underground deposits in the Aridune Desert.
items.effect: A luxury spice that changes flavor based on the food it's paired with.

items.name: Frostforge Iron
items.description: A unique iron ore that becomes harder and more resilient the colder it gets.
items.effect: The backbone of the Driftlands' renowned cold-resistant technology and architecture.

items.name: Living Clay
items.description: A malleable substance found in Grunholt Forest that seems to have a limited form of sentience.
items.effect: Used by master artisans to create sculptures that subtly change over time.

items.name: Volcanic Glass
items.description: Obsidian-like material with unique heat-resistant properties from Rugitus Coast.
items.effect: Crucial in the creation of specialized equipment for studying active volcanoes.

items.name: Echo Amber
items.description: Fossilized resin that seems to carry sound waves from the ancient past.
items.effect: Highly valued by historians and archaeologists  for its historical record capabilities.

items.name: Aetheric Crystal
items.description: Crystals from the Silverpeak Range that seem to defy gravity, floating when unconfined.
items.effect: The key component in Zephyria's experimental levitation technology.

items.name: Chameleon Ore
items.description: A metallic ore that changes color to match its surroundings.
items.effect: Extensively used in Sylvaris for advanced camouflage in both military and civilian applications.

items.name: Dreamdew Stone
items.description: Porous rocks from Evershroud City that absorb ambient psychic energy.
items.effect: Collected by the Astral Academy for their supposed prophetic properties when properly prepared.

items.name: Tideclock Coral
items.description: A species of coral from the Libra Coast that grows and recedes in perfect sync with the tides.
items.effect: Invaluable for oceanographers and used in highly accurate tide prediction devices.

items.name: Petrified Whisperwood
items.description: Petrified wood that seems to carry traces of conversations from ages past.
items.effect: Highly sought after by linguists and historians studying ancient Shiman languages.

items.name: Mistweave Cloak
items.description: A cloak woven from fibers treated with essence of Mistmantle moss from Evershroud City.
items.effect: Blends seamlessly with fog and mist.

items.name: Thundersole Boots
items.description: Boots with soles made from Stormstone-infused rubber, developed in Estwal City.
items.effect: Provides excellent traction on wet surfaces.

items.name: Sylvan Camouflage Suit
items.description: A full-body suit made with Chameleon Ore-infused fabric from Sylvaris.
items.effect: Subtly shifts color to match surroundings.

items.name: Frostline Jacket
items.description: A jacket lined with Frostforge Iron threads, popular in the Driftlands.
items.effect: Exceptional insulation against cold.

items.name: Zephyr Shoes
items.description: Lightweight shoes incorporating Aetheric Crystal technology from Zephyria.
items.effect: Makes the wearer feel almost weightless.

items.name: Aqua-Stride Boots
items.description: Boots made with Tideclock Coral-infused soles from the Libra Coast.
items.effect: Repels water and provides excellent traction on wet surfaces.

items.name: Resonance Earmuffs
items.description: Earmuffs crafted with Resonance Quartz from the Singing Dunes.
items.effect: Filters out harmful noise while enhancing important sounds.

items.name: Terravest
items.description: A vest lined with crushed Verdant Fossils from Mystaura.
items.effect: Subtle earthy scent that calms nearby animals.

items.name: Chrono-Weave Gloves
items.description: Gloves woven with threads of Chrono-diamond from the Temporal Ruins.
items.effect: Seems to speed up the wearer's reactions.

items.name: Skywatcher's Cap
items.description: A cap with a Nebula Glass-infused visor, crafted near Celestis.
items.effect: Enhances vision of distant and celestial objects.

items.name: Volcanic Treads
items.description: Boots with soles made from Volcanic Glass, designed for Rugitus Coast terrain.
items.effect: Excellent heat resistance and traction on rocky surfaces.

items.name: Echo Helm
items.description: A helm incorporating Echo Amber from ancient Shiman sites.
items.effect: Enhances the wearer's hearing and vocal projection.

items.name: Dreamweave Scarf
items.description: A scarf infused with essences from Dreamdew Stones of Evershroud City.
items.effect: Induces a sense of calm and clarity when worn.

items.name: Shimmersilk Gloves
items.description: Gloves woven from Shimmersilk Ore threads, prized in Venustia.
items.effect: Incredibly strong yet sensitive to touch.

items.name: SylvaShade Sunhat
items.description: A wide-brimmed sunhat from Sylvaris' popular outdoor brand, made with lightweight, breathable fabric.
items.effect: Popular among hikers and gardeners.

items.name: AquaFlow Swimwear
items.description: Sleek, form-fitting swimwear from Libra Coast's leading aquatic apparel maker.
items.effect: Favored by professional swimmers and beach-goers alike.

items.name: MistStep Sneakers
items.description: Comfortable, moisture-wicking sneakers from Evershroud City's top casual footwear brand.
items.effect: Known for their excellent arch support and grip on wet surfaces.

items.name: TempoCraft Wristwatch
items.description: A stylish, durable watch from Montevera's renowned timepiece manufacturer.
items.effect: Popular among adventurers and executives for its reliability.

items.name: ZephyrWeave Scarf
items.description: A light, airy scarf from Zephyria's trendy accessories line.
items.effect: Comes in a variety of patterns inspired by wind and cloud formations.

items.name: GeoTrek Boots
items.description: Sturdy hiking boots from the Silverpeak Range's premier outdoor gear company.
items.effect: Known for their durability and comfort on long treks.

items.name: LuminAid Reflective Vest
items.description: A safety vest with reflective strips, made by Venustia's leading workwear brand.
items.effect: Standard issue for many construction and night shift workers.

items.name: DesertBreeze Poncho
items.description: A light, loose-fitting poncho from an Aridune Desert fashion house.
items.effect: Designed to keep the wearer cool in hot climates.

items.name: FrostFolk Mittens
items.description: Cozy, insulated mittens from a popular Driftlands knitwear brand.
items.effect: Come in a variety of traditional Driftlands patterns.

items.name: EcoStride Sandals
items.description: Eco-friendly sandals made from recycled materials, by Mystaura's green fashion pioneer.
items.effect: Each purchase contributes to rainforest conservation efforts.

items.name: UrbanPulse Jacket
items.description: A sleek, multi-pocketed jacket from Astria's cutting-edge street fashion label.
items.effect: Popular among young professionals and trendsetters.

items.name: TideMesh Tank Top
items.description: A lightweight, quick-drying tank top from a Porto Auros beachwear company.
items.effect: Made with fabric that resists salt water stains.

items.name: SteelStep Safety Shoes
items.description: Durable work shoes from Ferronix's top industrial safety gear manufacturer.
items.effect: Meet all safety standards for construction and factory work.

items.name: ChronoChic Beret
items.description: A stylish beret from a boutique designer in Venustia.
items.effect: Each one has a unique, clock-inspired embroidery pattern.

items.name: NatureFit Yoga Pants
items.description: Flexible, breathable yoga pants from Grunholt Forest's eco-conscious activewear brand.
items.effect: Made from sustainable, plant-based fabrics.

items.name: UrbanPulse Smart Hoodie
items.description: A hoodie with built-in earphone channels and a device pocket with a clear, touch-sensitive panel.
items.effect: Popular among tech-savvy youth and young professionals.

items.name: UrbanPulse Adaptive Jeans
items.description: Jeans with a special fabric that adjusts to the wearer's body temperature.
items.effect: Known for being comfortable in a wide range of temperatures.

items.name: UrbanPulse Holographic Cap
items.description: A cap with a holographic bill that changes patterns based on light angle.
items.effect: A must-have accessory for fashion-forward individuals.

items.name: UrbanPulse Modular Backpack
items.description: A backpack with detachable compartments that can be rearranged or used separately.
items.effect: Favored by students and urban explorers for its versatility.

items.name: UrbanPulse Chameleon Sneakers
items.description: Sneakers with a special coating that subtly shifts color to match the ground.
items.effect: A hit among streetwear enthusiasts and urban artists.

items.name: UrbanPulse Pulse Scarf
items.description: A scarf with embedded fiber optics that can display patterns or text.
items.effect: Often used to show support at sporting events or concerts.

items.name: UrbanPulse Neo Trench Coat
items.description: A waterproof trench coat with subtle LED piping along the seams.
items.effect: Combines classic style with a futuristic twist.

items.name: UrbanPulse Flex-Fit Gloves
items.description: Thin, touchscreen-compatible gloves that adjust to hand temperature.
items.effect: Perfect for tech use in colder weather.

items.name: UrbanPulse Sonic Beanie
items.description: A beanie with built-in, thin speakers near the ears.
items.effect: Allows wearers to listen to music without obvious headphones.

items.name: UrbanPulse Cargo Shorts
items.description: Shorts with multiple hidden and quick-access pockets.
items.effect: Popular among urban adventurers and cosplayers.

items.name: UrbanPulse Augmented Glasses
items.description: Fashionable glasses with a subtle heads-up display on the lenses.
items.effect: Provides real-time information and navigation.

items.name: UrbanPulse Kinetic Belt
items.description: A belt that stores kinetic energy from movement and can charge small devices.
items.effect: Eco-friendly and practical for on-the-go city dwellers.

items.name: UrbanPulse Breeze Dress
items.description: A dress made of smart fabric that adjusts its ventilation based on body temperature.
items.effect: Ideal for unpredictable weather or indoor/outdoor events.

items.name: UrbanPulse Pocket Watch
items.description: A modernized pocket watch with both analog and digital displays.
items.effect: A trendy accessory that bridges classic and contemporary styles.

items.name: UrbanPulse Neon Socks
items.description: Socks with neon patterns that glow in UV light.
items.effect: Popular in nightclubs and raves.

items.name: Magnetic Nugget
items.description: A valuable piece of ore that has magnetic properties. Might fetch a high price when sold.
items.effect: Used in many industrial applications.

items.name: Thunderlash Whip
items.description: A crackling whip of pure lightning.

items.name: Maelstrom Trident
items.description: A mighty trident that commands the seas.

items.name: Inferno Blade
items.description: A blazing sword that burns with unquenchable fire.

items.name: Venustia Claws
items.description: A pair of long, deadly claws dripping with potent toxins.

items.name: Crown of Dreams
items.description: A coralline spiked crown that is translucent, lifted from Shadorm. Faint purple pulses of energy occasionally run along the spikes.

items.name: Ancient Coin
items.description: A coin from a lost age.
items.effect: Collectors and archaeologists are fond of these.

items.name: Drake Fossil
items.description: An ancient fossil shaped like a dragon.
items.effect: Must be studied more closely to reveal its secrets.

items.name: Thornkeep Berry Wine
items.description: A bottle of potent beverage made from berries grown on the town's vine structures, known for its restorative properties.
items.effect:
5 uses per bottle.
Restores 2d4+2 HP.
Grants advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour.

items.name: Wetland Clay Poultice
items.description: Medicinal clay gathered from specific wetland locations, used to draw out toxins and accelerate healing.
items.effect:
Cures the poisoned condition.
Restores 1d8 HP when applied to wounds.
Reduces swelling and inflammation, granting +5 temporary HP.

items.name: Vestra River Stone
items.description: Smooth stones from specific portions of the river that retain temperature for unusually long periods. Can be heated or cooled and used for treating injuries or maintaining body temperature.
items.effect:
When heated, provides resistance to cold damage for 1 hour.
When cooled, provides resistance to fire damage for 1 hour.
Can be used to treat muscle injuries, removing one level of exhaustion.

items.name: Thornkeep Heartwood
items.description: A piece of the original Mother Vine's core, thrumming with ancient energy and botanical potential.
items.effect: Accelerates plant growth in a 10-foot radius.

items.name: Clawine Claw
items.description: Tough claws that resemble thorns.
items.effect: Can be used to craft tools and weaponry.

items.name: Venomous Fang
items.description: A fang from a viper Pokémon that carries a potent venom.
items.effect: Can be used to craft tools and weaponry.

items.name: Poison Fang
items.description: An item that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.
items.effect: Holder adds prof. bonus to damage from poison-type moves (once per move).

items.name: Spectral Bark
items.description: Thin strips of bark from Octodendron with a faint bluish glow that persists for several days after harvesting. The bark feels solid to the touch but occasionally phases through solid objects.
items.effect: Can be ground into a powder and mixed with ink to create writings that are only visible at night or in darkened rooms. Useful in creating ghost-resistant containers when layered with other materials.

items.name: Umbral Core
items.description: A small, dense wooden sphere found at the center of an Octuber's trunk. It radiates cold and appears to absorb light around it.
items.effect: Can be carved into charms that reduce the ambient temperature in a small area. When ground and mixed with water, creates a paste that soothes burns and reduces inflammation.

items.name: Frost Heartwood
items.description: Pale, ice-streaked wood from the central trunk of Yukinarbor that remains cold to the touch even in warm environments.
items.effect: Excellent material for crafting handles of tools meant for hot environments. Burns with an eerie blue flame when ignited, providing light but minimal heat.

items.name: Ember Chitin
items.description: Reddish-orange fragments of Moltling exoskeleton that remain warm for several days after harvesting.
items.effect: Can be ground into a powder and added to clay to create pottery that retains heat unusually long. Popular for crafting drinking vessels in cold climates.

items.name: Inferno Scale
items.description: Segmented plates from the Scorab's carapace that pulse with internal heat, occasionally emitting small sparks when struck together.
items.effect: Used in the creation of fire-resistant armor and clothing. Chemists prize these scales for fire-based potions and warming tonics.

items.name: Magmacore Plating
items.description: Heavy metallic-looking Igniscairn carapace sections veined with glowing orange patterns that resemble flowing lava.
items.effect: Exceptional material for creating forge tools and fire-resistant armor. When ground into powder and mixed with oils, creates a paste that grants temporary resistance to fire damage when applied to skin.

items.name: Cloud Essence
items.description: A small vial of clear liquid from Salamandrop that seems to shift and swirl even when still. Collected from the body of a Salamandrop.
items.effect: When exposed to air, slowly transforms into a small, personal cloud that can provide shade or light precipitation. Herbalists use it to create mist for humidity-loving plants.

items.name: Storm Scale
items.description: Thin, translucent Hydrasylph scales that change color based on humidity and barometric pressure.
items.effect: Used by weather predictors to forecast rain with remarkable accuracy. Can be ground and mixed with ink to create weather-sensitive messages that change visibility based on atmospheric conditions.

items.name: Tempest Heart
items.description: A sphere of condensed water from Dracquatic that somehow maintains its shape without a container. Pulses with energy that resembles contained lightning.
items.effect: Prized by chemists for water and lightning potions. When properly stabilized, can be used to create compasses that point toward the nearest significant water source.

items.name: Desert Fang
items.description: A curved, sand-colored canine tooth from Sandit that seems to repel dirt and grit naturally.
items.effect: Useful as an engraving tool for detailed work on soft materials. When powdered and added to footwear, reduces slipping on loose surfaces like sand and gravel.

items.name: Hunter's Claw
items.description: A sharp, slightly curved Snift claw with microscopic serrations along its edge.
items.effect: Excellent for crafting cutting tools and climbing assists. When ground and mixed with oil, creates a paste that improves grip on smooth surfaces.

items.name: Nomad's Pelt
items.description: Patches of dense, water-resistant Bedouwara fur with a distinctive pattern.
items.effect: Excellent material for desert clothing, providing protection from both sun and cold night temperatures. Retains its properties even when fashioned into other items.

items.name: Static Whisker
items.description: Thin, wire-like Circuitail whiskers that occasionally discharge small sparks when touched or brought near conductive materials.
items.effect: Used in the creation of sensitive weather instruments and static electricity detectors. Chemists use them in potions designed to increase alertness and reaction time.

items.name: Conduction Fur
items.description: Patches of soft Amplifuzz fur that naturally attract and channel electricity, occasionally glowing faintly in the dark.
items.effect: Excellent insulating material when treated properly. Used in the creation of static-proof containers for delicate instruments or components.

items.name: Velocitrite
items.description: A crystalline formation found in the skull of Flarelex, pulsing with electrical energy that occasionally causes it to vibrate.
items.effect: Used in the creation of devices requiring constant, low-level electrical current. When ground into powder and applied to mechanical parts, reduces friction significantly.

items.name: Venom Quill
items.description: A small, hollow Toxchick feather containing trace amounts of mild toxin that causes numbness when contacted.
items.effect: Used by chemists in the creation of numbing agents and paralytic poisons. Herbalists use diluted extracts to create painkillers.

items.name: Poison Talon
items.description: A sharp, curved Toxiclaw talon with channels that secrete a more potent toxin capable of causing temporary paralysis.
items.effect: Prized by assassins and hunters for creating poisoned weapons. Chemists use them in creating more powerful antidotes, following the principle that poison cures poison.

items.name: Toxic Plumage
items.description: Iridescent Toxeak feathers that contain concentrated poison glands at their bases. The poison causes disorientation and weakness.
items.effect: Used in the creation of poison-detecting tools and powerful medicines when properly neutralized. Fashion enthusiasts prize these feathers for their beauty, once rendered safe.

items.name: Emotion Fluff
items.description: Soft, pink tufts from Hatenna that seem to pulse and change color slightly based on nearby emotional states.
items.effect: Used in the creation of mood-detecting instruments and emotion-soothing incense. When worn as an accessory, seems to have a calming effect on agitated Pokémon.

items.name: Silence Thread
items.description: Fine, silvery strands harvested from Hattrem's "hair" that seem to absorb sound in their immediate vicinity.
items.effect: Woven into fabrics to create sound-dampening cloths and privacy screens. Musicians use small amounts to create instruments with perfect acoustics.

items.name: Psychic Crest
items.description: The tall, distinctive horn-like structure atop Hatterene's head, which pulses with psychic energy when active.
items.effect: Powerful focus for psychic-type magic and abilities. When ground into powder and added to ink, creates writings that can only be read by those with psychic sensitivity.

items.name: Chromatic Shard
items.description: A multi-faceted crystal fragment from Diverigem that changes color based on the type of energy it was last exposed to. Often retains traces of elemental power.
items.effect: Used in the creation of elemental detection devices and diagnostic tools. Chemists use these shards to test the purity and potency of Type Gems.

items.name: Sapling Antler
items.description: A branch-like growth shed annually by Elkrince, featuring distinctive green bark and small leaf buds that remain viable for weeks after shedding.
items.effect: Excellent material for crafting plant growth accelerators and natural fertilizers. Woodworkers prize these antlers for creating living furniture that continues to sprout small leaves.

items.name: Living Stone Horn
items.description: A massive Elking antler with a unique composition that appears to be part plant and part mineral, featuring crystalline growths at the tips.
items.effect: Valuable material for creating sturdy staffs and tools that maintain a connection to natural energies. Ground into powder, serves as an exceptional fertilizer for difficult plants.

items.name: Grace Hoof
items.description: A small, perfectly preserved Elkrincess hoof shed during growth phases, featuring delicate golden patterns that seem to capture sunlight.
items.effect: Prized for creating good luck charms and protective amulets. When ground and added to soil, creates unusually vibrant flowers.

items.name: Crown Antler
items.description: An elegant, symmetrical Elqueen antler formation with a crystalline core that pulses with natural energy.
items.effect: Excellent material for crafting nature-based magical focuses and healing implements. When carved into jewelry, seems to enhance the wearer's natural charisma.

items.name: Spectral Sand
items.description: Fine grains of sand from Sandygast that appear normal but feel unusually cold and occasionally seem to move on their own when not observed directly.
items.effect: Used in the creation of hourglasses that measure time with unusual accuracy. When mixed with standard clay, creates pottery that preserves food for extended periods.

items.name: Castle Core
items.description: A dense, compressed mass of ghost-infused Pallossand sand that maintains its shape even when separated from the main body.
items.effect: Valuable material for creating structures that resist decay and weathering. Architects use small amounts in mortar for buildings intended to last for generations.

items.name: Tusker Ivory
items.description: Small, tough Boradin tusks with distinctive growth rings that indicate the Boradin's age and diet history.
items.effect: Excellent material for crafting durable buttons, dice, and small decorative items. When ground into powder and mixed with clay, creates ceramic that resists cracking.

items.name: Ironhide Plate
items.description: Sections of metallic-reinforced Tremboar hide that provide exceptional protection without sacrificing flexibility.
items.effect: Premium material for crafting armor that offers protection without restricting movement. When boiled and processed, creates leather that resists both cutting and piercing.

items.name: Swift Feather
items.description: A small, aerodynamically perfect Taillow feather that seems to cut through air with minimal resistance.
items.effect: Used in the creation of high-precision arrows and darts. Writers prize these feathers for creating quills that never need resharpening.

items.name: Navigator's Plume
items.description: A large, iridescent Swellow feather that seems to naturally orient itself toward magnetic north when suspended.
items.effect: Valuable for creating precision compasses and navigation instruments. Fashion designers prize these feathers for their beauty and unique properties.

items.name: Seeker Whisker
items.description: Extraordinarily sensitive Redent whiskers that continue to twitch and move in response to air currents for hours after harvesting.
items.effect: Used in the creation of sensitive detection devices and tremor sensors. Security experts incorporate them into trap detection systems.

items.name: Commander's Tail
items.description: The distinctive tipped tail that Sargent uses to signal its pack, retaining its bright coloration long after harvesting.
items.effect: Used to create durable ropes and striking signal flags. Military officers often incorporate these into their uniforms as status symbols.

items.name: Lily Pad
items.description: The distinctive leaf that grows on Lotad's head, which remains fresh and buoyant for weeks after harvesting.
items.effect: Excellent natural water purifier and fishing float. Herbalists use these leaves to create poultices that draw out toxins.

items.name: Rhythm Root
items.description: Fibrous, flexible roots used by Lombre that seem to pulse with a steady rhythm even after being harvested.
items.effect: Used to create water-resistant bindings and flexible containers. Musicians use these roots to craft instruments with unique tonal qualities.

items.name: Festival Crown
items.description: The distinctive, sombrero-like growth from Ludicolo's head, which seems to emanate a subtle, cheerful energy.
items.effect: Natural mood enhancer when kept in living spaces. Performers use fibers from these crowns to create costumes that seem to boost audience enthusiasm.

items.name: Spore Cap
items.description: The spotted Foongus mushroom cap that can be carefully harvested without triggering spore release.
items.effect: Used in the creation of powerful but non-lethal sleeping aids and sedatives. Chemists extract compounds for creating various medicinal fungal cultures.

items.name: Mimetic Tissue
items.description: Sections of the Amoonguss's body that can temporarily take on the coloration and texture of nearby objects.
items.effect: Valuable for creating camouflage fabrics and adaptive clothing. Artists use processed extracts to create paints that change color based on ambient light.

items.name: Venom Sac
items.description: A small, durable Larvasp organ containing mild toxins that cause localized swelling and pain but rarely serious harm.
items.effect: Used to create mild deterrent sprays and non-lethal defensive tools. Chemists extract compounds for creating antivenoms and pain relievers.

items.name: Striped Chitin
items.description: Segments of the distinctive black and yellow Vespair exoskeleton, lightweight but surprisingly durable.
items.effect: Excellent material for creating armor that doesn't restrict movement. Fashion designers use treated sections for creating statement accessories.

items.name: Spectral Stinger
items.description: The translucent, ghostly Phobee stinger that seems to phase in and out of physical reality when observed.
items.effect: Used to create weapons that can strike with unusual precision. Chemists extract the ghostly venom to create oils that can temporarily allow normal weapons to affect spectral entities.

items.name: Luminous Lure
items.description: The specialized light-emitting Glovish organ that continues to glow for several days after harvesting, changing colors based on ambient light levels.
items.effect: Natural source of soft, sustained light without heat. Used to create long-lasting emergency lights and underwater markers.

items.name: Abyssal Scale
items.description: Pitch-black Globyss scales that seem to absorb light, creating an unusual depth effect when viewed from different angles.
items.effect: Excellent material for creating items requiring light absorption or night camouflage. Scientists use these scales in optical research equipment.

items.name: Pressure Organ
items.description: A specialized internal Glowiathan organ that regulates extreme pressure differentials, contained in a crystalline membrane.
items.effect: Valuable component in the creation of deep-diving equipment and pressure-resistant containers. Engineers study these organs to improve underwater construction techniques.

items.name: Silk Gland
items.description: A small, pearl-like Caterpie gland that produces incredibly fine, strong silk when stimulated.
items.effect: Used to create high-strength threads and sutures. Fashion designers prize the silk for creating luxury garments that are surprisingly durable.

items.name: Cocoon Fragment
items.description: Pieces of the hardened Metapod shell, which exhibit remarkable memory properties, gradually returning to their original shape when deformed.
items.effect: Used to create molds for precision casting and emergency splints that adapt to body contours. Martial artists incorporate powdered shell into training wraps for joint protection.

items.name: Compound Lens
items.description: A section of the Butterfree compound eye structure, which continues to respond to light patterns after harvesting.
items.effect: Valuable component in the creation of sophisticated optical instruments and magnification devices. Researchers use these to study color patterns invisible to the human eye.

items.name: Ember Fur
items.description: Soft, russet Vulpix fur that remains unusually warm to the touch and occasionally gives off small sparks when stroked.
items.effect: Excellent insulation material for cold-weather clothing. When woven into blankets, provides warmth far beyond normal fabrics of similar weight.

items.name: Mystic Tail
items.description: A single tail from the nine possessed by Ninetales, which seems to move slightly of its own accord and radiates a subtle psychic energy.
items.effect: Powerful focus for fire and psychic abilities. Fashion designers risk curses to incorporate these magnificent tails into luxury items.

items.name: Patterned Scale
items.description: Diamond-shaped scales from a Venomire's body, featuring vibrant warning patterns that retain their bright coloration long after harvesting. Each scale contains tiny venom sacs at its base.
items.effect: Used to create poison-detecting tools and warning markers. Chemists extract the venom to create antidotes and non-lethal defensive sprays.

items.name: Basilisk Fang
items.description: A hollow, needle-sharp fang from a Venolisk that continues to produce small amounts of venom for several days after extraction. The venom causes temporary paralysis and intense discomfort.
items.effect: Valuable component in the creation of precision medical tools and paralytic agents. Hunters use properly treated fangs as arrowheads for capturing live prey.

items.name: Electric Pouch
items.description: A small, yellow sac harvested from a Pikachu's cheek that continues to generate small electrical charges for several days when properly preserved.
items.effect: Used to create small, sustainable power sources for delicate instruments. Engineers study these pouches to improve energy storage technologies.

items.name: Conductor Tail
items.description: The lightning bolt-shaped tail of a Raichu, which acts as a natural ground and electricity director. The tail retains its conductive properties long after being separated from the Pokémon.
items.effect: Exceptional material for creating lightning rods and electrical safety equipment. Electricians incorporate fragments into tools for working safely with high voltages.

items.name: Storm Crown
items.description: The distinctive crown-like growth from a Hagechu's head, which crackles with contained electrical energy and causes nearby metal objects to vibrate subtly.
items.effect: Powerful focus for electricity manipulation and weather prediction. Military organizations value these rare crowns for developing advanced communication technologies.

items.name: Resilient Scale
items.description: A seemingly ordinary fish scale from a Magikarp that demonstrates remarkable resilience, being nearly impossible to break despite its thin, lightweight nature.
items.effect: Used to create flexible but highly durable components for underwater equipment. Armorers incorporate these scales into designs requiring water resistance without added weight.

items.name: Sea Serpent Crest
items.description: A section of the impressive dorsal crest from a Gyarados, featuring razor-sharp edges that never seem to dull and a core that pulses with restrained draconic energy.
items.effect: Premium material for creating watercraft that can withstand rough seas. Naval architects incorporate these crests into designs for ships intended to navigate dangerous waters.

items.name: Training Band
items.description: The natural stone "bandage" wrapped around a Rockard's arm, which grows harder and more defined as the Pokémon trains. These bands flex slightly despite their stone composition.
items.effect: Used to create training weights that automatically adjust to the user's strength. Combat instructors value these bands for crafting practice weapons with ideal weight distribution.

items.name: Champion's Core
items.description: The dense, crystalline core found in the chest of a Crolder, which pulses with fighting energy and seems to harden further when exposed to strong emotions.
items.effect: Valuable focus material for fighting-type energy and abilities. Martial artists incorporate fragments into their training grounds to enhance discipline and power.

items.name: Flameweb Silk
items.description: Strands of silken thread harvested from a Charachnid, which remain warm to the touch and highly flammable, capable of catching fire with the slightest spark.
items.effect: Used to create quick-ignition fuses and emergency fire starters. Pyrotechnicians value these strands for creating precisely timed flame effects.

items.name: Magma Spinner
items.description: The specialized spinnerets from a Lavachnid that produce fire-resistant silk infused with volatile compounds. These organs remain capable of producing small amounts of silk for days after harvesting.
items.effect: Exceptional material for creating fire-resistant bindings and safety equipment. Firefighters incorporate processed spinnerets into their equipment for emergency escapes.

items.name: Shadow Fang
items.description: A sharp, curved canine tooth from a Poochyena that seems unusually dark, almost absorbing light rather than reflecting it. The tooth carries a faint aura of dark-type energy.
items.effect: Used to create tools for cutting through shadow and illusion effects. Security specialists incorporate these fangs into detection devices for spotting concealed objects.

items.name: Pack Leader's Mane
items.description: Coarse, dark fur from the impressive mane of a Mightyena, which seems to absorb sound and creates an intimidating silhouette in low light conditions.
items.effect: Excellent material for creating sound-dampening equipment and night camouflage. Hunters prize these manes for crafting stealth gear.

items.name: Strata Wing
items.description: A perfectly formed flight feather from a Chirquill, which seems unnaturally light yet maintains perfect rigidity and cuts through air with minimal resistance.
items.effect: Used to create high-precision arrows and darts with exceptional range. Messengers value these feathers for crafting quills that write smoothly under any conditions.

items.name: Frost Pinion
items.description: A massive primary feather from a Stratosoar's wing, perpetually frosted and radiating cold. Ice crystals continuously form and sublimate along its shaft in a mesmerizing pattern.
items.effect: Valuable component in the creation of cold-preservation systems and ice-based weapons. Explorers of hot regions prize these pinions for their cooling properties.

items.name: Psychic Soil
items.description: Earth that has passed through a Wormole's digestive system, imbued with faint psychic energy that causes it to occasionally shift and move on its own.
items.effect: Premium growing medium for psychically sensitive plants. Researchers use this soil to study the effects of psychic energy on plant growth and development.

items.name: World Coil
items.description: A single coil segment from the enormous body of a Jormungandr, which vibrates subtly with contained psychic and ground energy that can be felt rather than seen.
items.effect: Powerful focus for earth-moving abilities and psychic predictions related to geological events. Architects incorporate segments into foundations of important buildings to improve earthquake resistance.

items.name: Carved Shell Fragment
items.description: A piece of the meticulously shaped rock shell that a Dwebble carries and inhabits. The fragment shows signs of careful modification and bears faint markings from the Pokémon's tools.
items.effect: Used to create specialized tools for precise stoneworking. Architects value these fragments for studying natural structural principles.

items.name: Boulder Carapace
items.description: A section of the massive, flat stone that forms a Crustle's upper shell. Despite its enormous weight, the stone possesses a crystalline structure that makes it surprisingly resistant to cracking.
items.effect: Premium material for creating defensive structures and barriers. Military engineers incorporate pieces into defensive walls that need to withstand significant impact.

items.name: Living Mountain Core
items.description: A small crystalline formation from the heart of a Mountitan's body, which pulses with life energy and seems to have its own gravitational pull, drawing small objects toward it.
items.effect: Powerful focus for earth and life energies. Conservationists use these cores to rejuvenate damaged ecosystems and promote natural growth.

items.name: Serrated Fin
items.description: The razor-sharp dorsal fin from an Angish, featuring microscopic serrations that can cut through organic material with minimal pressure. The fin retains its edge indefinitely.
items.effect: Used to create surgical instruments and precision cutting tools. Chefs prize these fins for crafting knives that never need sharpening.

items.name: Predator Jaw
items.description: The powerful, articulated jaw of an Agonish, lined with multiple rows of needle-sharp teeth that regrow if removed. The jaw continues to snap reflexively for hours after harvesting.
items.effect: Valuable studying material for creating mechanical traps and locking mechanisms. Security specialists incorporate principles from these jaws into anti-tampering devices.

items.name: Frost Scale
items.description: A small, crystalline scale harvested from a Frizard's hide that remains cold to the touch regardless of ambient temperature. These scales form beautiful fractal patterns unique to each Frizard.
items.effect: Excellent cooling component for preserving perishable items. Beverage makers use these scales to create glasses that keep drinks perfectly chilled without dilution.

items.name: Venom Frost Gland
items.description: A specialized organ harvested from a Savagice that produces an unusual toxin with extreme cold-preserving properties. The gland continues to secrete small amounts of this substance for days after removal.
items.effect: Used to create powerful cold-based weapons and paralytic agents. Chemists extract compounds for creating freeze-resistant lubricants and specialized preservatives.

items.name: Evolution Catalyst
items.description: A small, pulsing organ harvested from the rare Salo Pokémon. The catalyst shifts and changes color constantly, never maintaining the same appearance for more than a few seconds.
items.effect: Valuable research material for studying Pokémon evolution processes. Breeders use tiny fragments to stimulate development in stagnant Pokémon.

items.name: Compound Mandible
items.description: The specialized jaw structure from a Secto, featuring both cutting and crushing surfaces designed for processing multiple types of food. The mandible retains traces of the Pokémon's toxic secretions.
items.effect: Used to create versatile tools that serve multiple functions. Poison specialists study these mandibles to develop more effective antidotes.

items.name: Shadow Toed Claw
items.description: A curved, darkened claw harvested from an Umbro's foot that seems to blend into shadows when not directly observed. The claw emits a faint aura of dark-type energy.
items.effect: Used in the creation of tools for manipulating shadows and dark energy. Infiltration specialists prize these claws for crafting climbing tools that leave minimal evidence.

items.name: Wing Membrane
items.description: A section of the developing wing structure from a young Drago, which continues to grow slowly even after being harvested if kept in proper conditions.
items.effect: Valuable material for creating lightweight, durable fabrics and gliding equipment. Researchers study these membranes to develop better flight suits.

items.name: Charge Node
items.description: A specialized organ harvested from a Volto that generates and stores electrical energy. The node continues to produce small electrical pulses for weeks after removal when exposed to light.
items.effect: Used to create sustainable power sources for small devices. Engineers incorporate these nodes into designs for self-charging equipment.

items.name: Reflective Scale
items.description: A small, mirror-like scale from a Lumo's body that seems to redirect energy rather than absorb it. The scale creates beautiful prismatic effects when light passes through it.
items.effect: Valuable component in the creation of light-manipulating devices and protective equipment. Defenders use these scales to create shields effective against energy-based attacks.

items.name: Warrior Knuckle
items.description: The reinforced bone structure from a Fisto's hand, which shows remarkable density and structural optimization for delivering powerful strikes without self-damage.
items.effect: Used to create impact-resistant materials and striking weapons. Martial arts trainers study these structures to improve hand-protection designs.

items.name: Ember Spine
items.description: One of the flame-generating spines that run along a Fuego's back, which continues to produce small flames when agitated even after harvesting.
items.effect: Natural fire starter that works even in damp conditions. Survival experts prize these spines for creating reliable emergency fire sources.

items.name: Aerodynamic Crest
items.description: The distinctive head crest from an Aero, which demonstrates perfect aerodynamic properties and seems to naturally orient itself to reduce air resistance.
items.effect: Used to create improved designs for vehicles and flight equipment. Athletes incorporate principles from these crests into specialized gear for reducing drag.

items.name: Phantom Essence
items.description: A swirling, semi-material substance harvested from a Spectro during its manifestation phase. The essence appears as a luminous mist that can be contained in special vials.
items.effect: Used to create inks and paints that can be seen in complete darkness. Ghost-type specialists use this essence to detect and interact with normally invisible spectral entities.

items.name: Germination Pod
items.description: A specialized seed-like organ harvested from a Seedo that contains concentrated growth energy and dozens of different plant genetic materials.
items.effect: Powerful growth stimulator for struggling plants. Agricultural specialists use diluted extracts to revitalize damaged farmland.

items.name: Heat-Storing Crystal
items.description: A crystalline formation harvested from a Silico's body that absorbs and stores thermal energy during the day, releasing it slowly over time.
items.effect: Used to create natural heating elements and temperature-regulating materials. Desert travelers prize these crystals for providing warmth during cold nights.

items.name: Frost Path Residue
items.description: The specialized secretion from a Subsiro's feet that instantly freezes water into walkable ice. The substance remains effective for weeks if properly preserved.
items.effect: Used to create instant ice bridges and freeze small water bodies. Winter rescue teams utilize this substance for emergency water crossings.

items.name: Thought Strand
items.description: A fine, nearly invisible filament harvested from a Psycho's brain that pulses with psychic energy and occasionally moves of its own accord, seeming to react to nearby thoughts.
items.effect: Valuable component in the creation of psychic detection devices and communication enhancement tools. Psychic trainers use these strands to improve their mental focusing techniques.

items.name: Sonic Stone
items.description: A specially resonant stone harvested from a Granito's body that vibrates at specific frequencies when struck, producing distinctive musical tones.
items.effect: Used to create instruments with perfect pitch and sound-based tools. Communication specialists incorporate these stones into long-distance signaling devices.

items.name: Mental Alloy
items.description: A piece of the unique metallic exoskeleton generated by a Mekko through psychic manipulation of ambient minerals. The metal retains a connection to psychic energy, occasionally reshaping slightly in response to strong nearby emotions.
items.effect: Exceptionally responsive material for crafting armor and tools that seem to anticipate the user's needs. Engineers study this metal to develop more intuitive machinery.

items.name: Pressure Sphere
items.description: A small, perfectly spherical organ harvested from a Hydro that contains highly compressed water maintained in a stable state by specialized membranes.
items.effect: Used to create powerful water-projecting tools and emergency water supplies. Marine researchers use these spheres to study water properties under extreme pressure.

items.name: Navigation Feather
items.description: A specialized primary feather from an Albawk's wing that seems to naturally orient toward large bodies of water. The feather responds to changes in humidity and air pressure with subtle movements.
items.effect: Used to create precise weather prediction instruments and water-finding tools. Sailors prize these feathers for navigational aids when visibility is poor.

items.name: Thermal Wing
items.description: A complete wing section from an Albaross, featuring specialized feathers and oil glands that provide exceptional insulation against cold and moisture.
items.effect: Premium material for creating cold-weather gear and waterproof equipment. Arctic explorers value these wings for crafting survival gear for extreme environments.

items.name: Silver Scale
items.description: A small, reflective scale from a Stakerel that shimmers with a distinctive silver-blue hue and remains surprisingly fresh long after harvesting.
items.effect: Used to create lures and fishing equipment with enhanced effectiveness. Nutritionists value these scales for their high mineral content when properly processed.

items.name: Shredator Tooth
items.description: A razor-sharp tooth from a Shredator that seems capable of cutting through almost any organic material with minimal pressure. The tooth regrows quickly on the living Pokémon.
items.effect: Exceptional material for creating precision cutting tools and surgical instruments. Marine hunters prize these teeth for crafting effective fishing spears.

items.name: Pressure Pincer
items.description: The specialized front claw harvested from a Grypple that can exert tremendous gripping force despite its relatively small size. The pincer continues to close reflexively when stimulated even after removal from the Pokémon.
items.effect: Used to create powerful clamps and gripping tools. Engineers study these pincers to improve mechanical grip designs for construction and manufacturing.

items.name: Battle Claw
items.description: The massive, battle-hardened pincer from a Krestler that features specialized ridges and serrations developed through countless conflicts. The claw's muscle structure exhibits unusual density and tension properties.
items.effect: Premium material for creating shields and defensive equipment. Combat instructors study these claws to develop better blocking techniques and defensive stances.

items.name: Living Coral
items.description: A section of the specialized coral formation that grows symbiotically on a Kroraleef's back. The coral remains alive for weeks after careful harvesting if kept in appropriate conditions.
items.effect: Used to create water purification systems and reef restoration projects. Marine biologists study these coral samples to develop better reef conservation techniques.

items.name: Guardian Shell
items.description: A portion of the distinctive rock-hard shell from a Krabemone, featuring intricate coral patterns and remarkable structural integrity despite its relatively light weight.
items.effect: Excellent material for creating defensive equipment that doesn't restrict mobility. Coastal architects incorporate design principles from these shells into storm-resistant structures.

items.name: Nematocyst Sac
items.description: A specialized stinging organ harvested from a Jelleem that contains potent toxins capable of causing paralysis in small creatures. The sac remains active for several days if properly preserved.
items.effect: Used to create non-lethal defensive sprays and paralytic agents. Chemists extract compounds for creating pain relievers and specialized anesthetics.

items.name: Translucent Membrane
items.description: A section of the bell-shaped body structure from a Hugeem, which demonstrates remarkable tensile strength despite appearing delicate and translucent. The membrane continues to pulse rhythmically for days after harvesting.
items.effect: Valuable material for creating waterproof, flexible containers and protective coverings. Marine researchers use these membranes to develop better diving equipment.

items.name: Adhesive Tentacle
items.description: One of the specialized tentacles from a Croager that secretes a powerful adhesive substance capable of securing the Pokémon to virtually any surface. The tentacle continues to produce small amounts of adhesive for days after removal.
items.effect: Used to create industrial-strength adhesives and emergency repair materials. Search and rescue teams incorporate these adhesives into climbing equipment for difficult terrain.

items.name: Entangling Vine
items.description: A specialized tentacle-vine hybrid harvested from a Clawine that demonstrates both plant and animal characteristics. The vine responds to touch by attempting to wrap around nearby objects.
items.effect: Excellent material for creating snares and flexible restraints. Security specialists use these vines to develop better containment systems for dangerous creatures.

items.name: Prismatic Wing Scale
items.description: A smallscale from a Delwing's wing that creates beautiful rainbow effects when light passes through it. These scales are arranged in complex patterns unique to each individual Delwing.
items.effect: Used to create anti-counterfeiting measures and specialized optical instruments. Artists incorporate these scales into distinctive pigments that change color depending on viewing angle.

items.name: Hydrophobic Wing
items.description: A complete wing section from an Agiluzz, featuring specialized structures that repel water so effectively that the surface remains completely dry even when submerged.
items.effect: Premium material for creating waterproof equipment and specialized coatings. Engineers study these wings to develop better water-resistant technologies.

items.name: Serrated Scythe
items.description: One of the massive, blade-like forelimbs from a Prayblade, featuring microscopic serrations capable of slicing through tough vegetation and prey alike. The blade maintains its edge indefinitely without maintenance.
items.effect: Exceptional material for creating cutting tools and weapons with unsurpassed sharpness. Military organizations value these blades for developing advanced cutting technologies.

items.name: Illusory Stone
items.description: A small, seemingly ordinary rock from a Pebbling's body that feels surprisingly soft and warm to the touch despite its stone-like appearance. The stone occasionally emits a faint, pleasant glow.
items.effect: Used to create comfort items and stress-relief tools. Therapists incorporate these stones into treatment for patients with anxiety or trauma.

items.name: Loyal Spore
items.description: A specialized reproductive structure from a Promush that forms a symbiotic relationship with compatible plant life. The spore responds to verbal commands for weeks after harvesting if properly preserved.
items.effect: Valuable component in creating enhanced agricultural products and garden maintenance tools. Botanists study these spores to develop better plant communication techniques.

items.name: Oath Blade
items.description: The distinctive arm-blade harvested from an Underoath, which exhibits both metallic and organic properties. The blade edge realigns its molecular structure automatically to maintain optimal sharpness.
items.effect: Premium material for creating tools that require minimal maintenance and exceptional durability. Military organizations value these blades for developing specialized equipment.

items.name: Knight's Crest
items.description: The distinctive crown-like growth from a Mossworn's head, which pulses with residual life energy and seems to respond to statements of loyalty and devotion.
items.effect: Powerful focus for nature-based magic and abilities. Leaders incorporate symbolic elements from these crests into ceremonial regalia.

items.name: Aurora Feather
items.description: A delicate, translucent feather from a Felichim that seems to capture the colors of dawn within its structure. The feather emits a faint, warm light in darkness.
items.effect: Used to create illumination devices that produce natural, calming light. Artists incorporate these feathers into works designed to evoke peace and tranquility.

items.name: Mythic Quill
items.description: A magnificent primary feather from a Tigriffon's wing, featuring intricate patterns that seem to tell ancient stories when viewed in the light of dawn or dusk.
items.effect: Powerful focus for fairy-type magic and abilities. Historians value these quills for recording important events, believing they ensure the truth is preserved.

items.name: Colony Thread
items.description: A fine, incredibly strong silk strand produced by a Swarmy that forms the basis of their colonial nests. The thread demonstrates unusual tensile properties and resistance to environmental damage.
items.effect: Used to create durable bindings and repair materials for delicate items. Engineers study these threads to develop better structural support systems for buildings.

items.name: Hive Mind Node
items.description: A specialized neural cluster harvested from an Ordus that enables it to coordinate entire colonies of Swarmy. The node pulses with faint electrical activity for weeks after careful extraction.
items.effect: Valuable research material for studying swarm behavior and collective intelligence. Military strategists study these nodes to develop better coordination tactics for large groups.

items.name: Primordial Ice Core
items.description: A small fragment of the crystalline core from the titan Pokémon Blizzgarr, which never melts regardless of temperature and occasionally releases bursts of electrical energy.
items.effect: Used to create the most powerful cold-based weapons and temperature control systems. Scientists study these fragments to develop better energy storage technologies.

items.name: Guardian Feather
items.description: A single, incandescent feather from the cosmic guardian Pokémon Seraphlyte, which radiates a gentle, protective light and seems to phase between material and immaterial states.
items.effect: Powerful focus for protective magic and abilities. Religious organizations value these extremely rare feathers as sacred relics believed to ward off evil.

items.name: Crystalline Scale
items.description: A diamond-hard scale from the dragon Pokémon Razard that refracts light into complex patterns and can focus energy into concentrated beams.
items.effect: Premium material for creating precision optical instruments and cutting tools. Gemcutters study these scales to improve their techniques for working with precious stones.

items.name: Mantle Fragment
items.description: A small piece of the molten core from the Pokémon Conflagirant, which radiates intense heat and occasionally bubbles with earth energy despite its solid appearance.
items.effect: Used to create the most powerful heat-based weapons and forges. Metallurgists prize these fragments for their ability to melt even the most resistant materials.

items.name: Continental Crust
items.description: A small section of the armored hide from the legendary Pokémon Groudon, which pulses with primordial earth energy and occasionally causes nearby soil to become enriched with nutrients.
items.effect: Powerful focus for earth-shaping abilities and ground-type energy. Geologists study these extremely rare fragments to better understand tectonic processes.

items.name: Abyssal Membrane
items.description: A small section of the specialized skin from the legendary Pokémon Kyogre, which maintains perfect hydration regardless of environment and seems to subtly influence nearby water.
items.effect: Used to create the most effective water purification systems and weather prediction tools. Marine biologists study these extremely rare samples to better understand ocean ecosystems.

items.name: Celestial Scale
items.description: A single iridescent scale from the legendary Pokémon Rayquaza that seems to contain the vastness of the sky within its structure. The scale shifts between various hues of green and gold and occasionally pulses with cosmic energy.
items.effect: Considered the ultimate focus for weather manipulation and air-current control. Meteorologists fortunate enough to study these extremely rare scales have revolutionized weather prediction models.

items.name: Sonar Ear
items.description: The specialized sound-gathering organ harvested from a Caredevil that continues to twitch and orient toward sounds for days after careful removal. The ear's structure demonstrates remarkable sensitivity to even the faintest noises.
items.effect: Used to create highly sensitive listening devices and sound detection equipment. Musicians value these organs for developing instruments with exceptional acoustic properties.

items.name: Soul Echo Membrane
items.description: A specialized tissue harvested from a Faredevil that seems capable of capturing and replaying fragments of sounds from the past. The membrane vibrates subtly in response to emotional states of nearby beings.
items.effect: Valuable research material for developing communication devices that function in difficult conditions. Psychologists study these membranes to better understand emotional processing.

items.name: Otherworld Ember
items.description: A small, perpetually burning flame harvested from an Infernity that burns with a dark, purple-black fire that consumes no oxygen and produces no heat. The flame seems to flicker in time with unseen presences.
items.effect: Used to create specialized illumination for exploring areas between planes of existence. Ghost-type specialists use these embers to develop better methods for communicating with spirits.

items.name: Volcanic Core
items.description: A small fragment of the molten heart of the titan Pokémon Magmoar that maintains its liquid state regardless of environmental temperature. The core occasionally discharges electrical energy while cycling through various stages of molten activity.
items.effect: Used to create the most powerful heat and electricity-based weapons and tools. Vulcanologists study these fragments to better understand magma chamber dynamics and predict eruptions.

items.name: Magnetized Plating
items.description: A section of the armored exterior from the titan Pokémon Ferrarg that continuously generates a powerful magnetic field capable of attracting or repelling metallic objects at will. The plate reconfigures its molecular structure to maintain optimal defensive properties.
items.effect: Premium material for creating electromagnetic devices and protective equipment. Engineers study these plates to develop better electrical systems and magnetic technology.

items.name: Golden Horn Fragment
items.description: A small section of the distinctive gold-hued horn from a Triceros that conducts electricity with remarkable efficiency. The horn fragment continues to accumulate static charge from the environment after harvesting.
items.effect: Valuable component in creating electrical conduits and power management systems. Jewelers prize these fragments for creating distinctive ornaments with unique properties.

items.name: Rhino Plate
items.description: A heavy, incredibly durable section of the metallic hide from a Rhinaurus that demonstrates both remarkable conductivity and insulation properties depending on its orientation. The plate self-repairs minor scratches over time.
items.effect: Exceptional material for creating defensive equipment that protects against electrical attacks. Military organizations value these plates for developing specialized armor for operations involving electrical hazards.

items.name: Healing Pollen
items.description: Microscopic, glittering spores harvested from a Pixee that exhibit remarkable healing properties when applied to wounds or ingested in carefully controlled doses. The pollen glows with a soft, pink light in darkness.
items.effect: Used to create powerful healing salves and antidotes for various toxins. Medical researchers study these spores to develop better treatments for stubborn ailments.

items.name: Restoration Bloom
items.description: The flower-like appendage harvested from a Wispee that pulses with concentrated life energy and occasionally releases small bursts of healing pollen when stimulated.
items.effect: Powerful focus for healing magic and abilities. Medical organizations value these extremely rare blooms for developing treatments for supposedly incurable conditions.

items.name: Ignition Stone
items.description: A small, seemingly ordinary rock from a Flignit's body that produces sparks when struck against virtually any surface. The stone grows uncomfortably hot when held for extended periods.
items.effect: Reliable fire starter that functions in nearly any environment. Survival experts prize these stones for creating emergency heat sources in harsh conditions.

items.name: Explosive Core
items.description: The specialized internal organ harvested from a Flareblit that contains highly volatile gases controlled by a unique membrane system. The core occasionally releases small puffs of harmless flame as pressure builds and releases.

items.name: Tundra Tusk
items.description: One of the large, curved ivory structures harvested from a Lodoth that maintains freezing temperatures at its core regardless of environmental conditions. The tusk occasionally accumulates frost even in warm environments.
items.effect: Used to create cold-preservation systems and specialized tools for arctic exploration. Ivory carvers prize these tusks for their unique thermal properties and durability.

items.name: Woolly Insulation
items.description: A section of the dense, specialized hair harvested from a Pelsdoth that provides perfect insulation against even the most extreme cold. The fur maintains its warming properties indefinitely after harvesting and seems resistant to all forms of damage or decay.
items.effect: Premium material for creating the most effective cold-weather gear and thermal insulation systems. Arctic expedition leaders value this fur for equipment meant for the most extreme environments.

items.name: Vibration Antenna
items.description: One of the specialized sensory appendages harvested from a Thornug that continues to respond to vibrations and movement for weeks after careful extraction. The antenna seems capable of distinguishing between different types of movement with remarkable precision.
items.effect: Used to create highly sensitive motion detection systems and seismic monitoring equipment. Security specialists value these antennae for developing early warning systems.

items.name: Communication Spine
items.description: One of the distinctive, vibration-generating structures harvested from a Thohorn that can produce complex patterns of movement to convey information. The spine continues to respond to nearby vibrations for days after careful extraction.
items.effect: Used to create specialized communication devices that function in environments where sound is impractical. Military organizations value these spines for developing covert signaling systems.

items.name: Aquatic Lung
items.description: The specialized respiratory organ harvested from a Pelagos that can extract oxygen from both air and water with remarkable efficiency. The lung continues to process and purify air for days after careful extraction if kept in appropriate conditions.
items.effect: Used to create advanced breathing apparatus and water purification systems. Marine researchers value these lungs for developing better underwater exploration equipment.

items.name: Pack Bond Gland
items.description: A specialized organ harvested from an Archilagos that produces complex pheromones for coordinating group hunting and defense. The gland continues to produce these compounds for weeks after careful extraction if properly preserved.
items.effect: Valuable research material for studying group coordination and social bonding. Military strategists study these glands to develop better understanding of optimal small-unit tactics.

items.name: Kelp Fin Crown
items.description: A section of the distinctive head crest harvested from a Pelarchilagos that pulses with dominance energy and seems to analyze territorial boundaries automatically. The crest occasionally emits low-frequency sounds that affect the behavior of lesser creatures.
items.effect: Powerful focus for territorial influence and group leadership. Marine conservation experts value these extremely rare crests for establishing protected aquatic zones.

items.name: Nutritive Shell
items.description: Fragments of the specialized egg casing from a Chicklet that contains concentrated nutrients and growth factors. The shell pieces continue to release small amounts of these compounds when placed in water.
items.effect: Used to create high-efficiency fertilizers and growth supplements. Agricultural researchers study these shell fragments to develop better understanding of optimal nutrition profiles for rapid development.

items.name: Maternal Feather
items.description: A specialized down feather harvested from a Clucky that radiates gentle warmth and seems to have calming effects on young creatures nearby. The feather maintains its warmth indefinitely after harvesting.
items.effect: Excellent material for creating incubation equipment and comfort items for young animals. Childcare specialists value these feathers for developing better nurturing environments.

items.name: Dominance Comb
items.description: The distinctive red crest harvested from a Noirow that pulses with territorial energy and produces subtle intimidation fields. The comb occasionally stands more erect when near potential challengers.
items.effect: Used to create territorial markers and dominance training tools. Behavioral psychologists study these combs to better understand hierarchy establishment and maintenance.

items.name: Dawn Talon
items.description: One of the specialized claws harvested from a Solatrice that seems to capture and store sunlight within its structure. The talon glows with a gentle, golden light during dawn and dusk hours.
items.effect: Used to create solar energy collection systems and light-based therapeutic tools. Medical researchers study these talons to develop better treatments for seasonal affective disorders.

items.name: Lunar Wing
items.description: A complete wing section harvested from a Lunatrice that seems to capture and refract moonlight in mysterious patterns. The wing changes appearance throughout the lunar cycle, becoming nearly transparent during the new moon and brilliantly luminous during the full moon.
items.effect: Powerful focus for lunar energy and divination. Astronomers value these extremely rare wings for studying the effects of lunar cycles on terrestrial phenomena.

items.name: Divine Essence
items.description: A small crystalline formation harvested from one of the divine Avatar Pokémon that pulses with concentrated elemental energy specific to its origin (water, electricity, fire, or poison).
